A London-listed luxury real estate developer, investor, and asset manager creating high-quality communities, landmark destinations, and lifestyle-driven assets across premier global markets, including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and London, spanning premium hospitality, commercial, entertainment, and exclusive golf communities.
We own, invest, develop, and operate high-end real estate that delivers long-term value, combining global partnerships, strong fundamentals, and disciplined execution across target international property markets.

Global Real Estate Developments & Luxury Properties
At the core of DarGlobal is a disciplined development model focused on delivering architecturally distinctive residential and mixed-use assets in high-growth global locations. From landmark towers featuring premium luxury apartments in Dubai and Qatar to bespoke, ultra-luxury villas in Spain and the GCC, every project is meticulously designed to balance elite desirability, structural efficiency, and long-term capital appreciation.

Building Luxury Communities
We create fully integrated communities designed for long-term living, investment stability, and enduring value.
From masterplanned environments in key regions to ultra-exclusive residential enclaves across UAE real estate and European markets, each community is built around connectivity, luxury lifestyle, and scarcity, ensuring sustained demand and generational relevance.

HOSPITALITY & LEISURE
We develop and operate hospitality-led assets in partnership with world-class global brands.
Our approach combines location, brand power, and operational excellence to create destinations that generate recurring income while enhancing the value of surrounding real estate.

Private membership
Dar Global is building a new generation of private membership clubs across its global destinations.
From an exclusive private members club in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to curated experiences and upcoming hospitality destinations for luxury properties in Dubai, these spaces are designed for residents, investors, and select members of our global community.

GOLF
Golf is a cornerstone of our community strategy, anchoring premium developments with globally recognized courses and club experiences.
These elite assets elevate positioning, attract high-net-worth buyers looking to buy luxury villas in Spain and the Middle East, and contribute to both lifestyle appeal and long-term asset performance.

Commercial
We develop high-quality commercial assets designed to generate stable, recurring income.
Strategically located and carefully curated, our commercial developments complement our residential portfolios across Qatar real estate and international markets while creating long-term value for investors.

asseT MANAGEMENT
REGULATED CAPITAL | GLOBAL REACH
| PARTNERSHIP FIRST
Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP) is the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary of DarGlobal, headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). DGCP deploys capital across global real estate markets, structuring premium opportunities in equity, debt, and hybrid instruments across the GCC, European, and US gateway markets. Built on the Group's premier development platform and powered by institutional discipline and analytical rigor, DGCP creates access to high-conviction strategies and proprietary deal flow for qualified investors and strategic partners.

About DarGlobal
Discover DarGlobal: Your Gateway to Luxury Real Estate Investment
DarGlobal is a premier international luxury real estate investment and development platform specialising in architecturally distinctive, design-led residences in the world's most sought-after destinations. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, we connect global capital with curated luxury living and property investment opportunities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and beyond.
Our elite portfolio spans masterplanned communities, branded luxury apartments, and hospitality-led destinations developed in partnership with iconic names from automotive, fashion, and hospitality. Whether investors seek recurring rental income, long-term capital appreciation, or geographic diversification, DarGlobal structures high-value real estate assets to align perfectly with institutional risk and return objectives.
With a seasoned leadership team, robust corporate governance, and a differentiated lifestyle brand, DarGlobal offers unparalleled access to exclusive projects that blend world-class architecture, resilient market fundamentals, and enduring desirability for global property buyers.

Global Real Estate Developments & Luxury Properties
At the core of DarGlobal is a disciplined development model focused on delivering architecturally distinctive residential and mixed-use assets in high-growth global locations. From landmark towers featuring premium luxury apartments in Dubai and Qatar to bespoke, ultra-luxury villas in Spain and the GCC, every project is meticulously designed to balance elite desirability, structural efficiency, and long-term capital appreciation.

Building Luxury Communities
We create fully integrated communities designed for long-term living, investment stability, and enduring value.
From masterplanned environments in key regions to ultra-exclusive residential enclaves across UAE real estate and European markets, each community is built around connectivity, luxury lifestyle, and scarcity, ensuring sustained demand and generational relevance.

HOSPITALITY & LEISURE
We develop and operate hospitality-led assets in partnership with world-class global brands.
Our approach combines location, brand power, and operational excellence to create destinations that generate recurring income while enhancing the value of surrounding real estate.

Private membership
Dar Global is building a new generation of private membership clubs across its global destinations.
From an exclusive private members club in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to curated experiences and upcoming hospitality destinations for luxury properties in Dubai, these spaces are designed for residents, investors, and select members of our global community.

GOLF
Golf is a cornerstone of our community strategy, anchoring premium developments with globally recognized courses and club experiences.
These elite assets elevate positioning, attract high-net-worth buyers looking to buy luxury villas in Spain and the Middle East, and contribute to both lifestyle appeal and long-term asset performance.

Commercial
We develop high-quality commercial assets designed to generate stable, recurring income.
Strategically located and carefully curated, our commercial developments complement our residential portfolios across Qatar real estate and international markets while creating long-term value for investors.

asseT MANAGEMENT
REGULATED CAPITAL | GLOBAL REACH
| PARTNERSHIP FIRST
Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP) is the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary of DarGlobal, headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). DGCP deploys capital across global real estate markets, structuring premium opportunities in equity, debt, and hybrid instruments across the GCC, European, and US gateway markets. Built on the Group's premier development platform and powered by institutional discipline and analytical rigor, DGCP creates access to high-conviction strategies and proprietary deal flow for qualified investors and strategic partners.

We are pioneering new ways to access premium real estate investments through tokenization and digital ownership structures.
By leveraging advanced property technology, we aim to enhance liquidity, broaden investor access, and create more efficient pathways into high-quality luxury real estate assets globally.

About DarGlobal
Discover DarGlobal: Your Gateway to Luxury Real Estate Investment
DarGlobal is a premier international luxury real estate investment and development platform specialising in architecturally distinctive, design-led residences in the world's most sought-after destinations. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, we connect global capital with curated luxury living and property investment opportunities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and beyond.
Our elite portfolio spans masterplanned communities, branded luxury apartments, and hospitality-led destinations developed in partnership with iconic names from automotive, fashion, and hospitality. Whether investors seek recurring rental income, long-term capital appreciation, or geographic diversification, DarGlobal structures high-value real estate assets to align perfectly with institutional risk and return objectives.
With a seasoned leadership team, robust corporate governance, and a differentiated lifestyle brand, DarGlobal offers unparalleled access to exclusive projects that blend world-class architecture, resilient market fundamentals, and enduring desirability for global property buyers.

title: About Us
text:
About Us Register Interest +966 8001188081 English العربية DISCOVER DARGLOBAL LIVE ALL IN DarGlobal develops real estate that speaks for itself, where lifestyle and value come together. We work with trusted global partners to create homes, communities, and destinations that grow in meaning and worth over time. Our approach is simple: deliver with integrity, design with care, and build with purpose. For those who see the world as their home, DarGlobal offers not just investment, but belonging - value you can measure, and pride you can feel, and a legacy you can pass forward. Learn More ZIAD EL CHAAR Founder & Chief Executive Officer The end result that we want to deliver to you is simple: happiness. Global presence Global offices Salses Offices City project Our project PROUDLY LISTED ON THE LONDON STOCK EXCHANGE WHERE AMBITION LIVES. Our premium properties are strategically located in established and emerging markets. Creating opportunities to expand your world. While growing your wealth. Our international portfolio spans exquisite residences, vacation retreats, world-class hospitality, and developments with iconic luxury brands, including Aston Martin, and Lamborghini. Design. Lifestyle. Investment value. Every DarGlobal property seeks to enrich all three. YOUR WORLD. YOUR WAY. True global citizens want to live without borders. Or compromises. We offer thoughtfully designed homes in desirable settings that cater to your international way of life. Freedom and flexibility. Comfort and culture. Security and service. Wherever you go, find the fundamentals here. BUILT ON TRUST. We draw on over 31 years of luxury development experience to move with agility. Adapting to stay ahead of the market. Anticipating investors’ needs. Leveraging exceptional talent and partnerships. Always guided by purpose. Our commitment to quality and people-first thinking sets us apart. We don’t just build differently. We’re built different. title: AIDA 360°
text:
AIDA 360° Muscat Oman Welcome to AIDA 360° - your dedicated DarGlobal concierge for everything that makes owning at AIDA effortless. From residency permits and fast-track banking to holiday-let management, remote handovers, and fee-free resale, every service you might need sits one click away. JOIN OUR TELEGRAM CHANNEL & STAY UPDATED tailored services Residency Permit Facilitation Enjoy a seamless process in securing an Omani residency permit through property ownership, with guidance on documentation and eligibility criteria. learn more Client-to-Client Referral Program Introduce friends or family to the AIDA lifestyle and receive exclusive rewards when your referrals become homeowners. learn more Omani Bank Account Facilities Open a local bank account with the support of our team, ensuring access to financial services in Oman for property-related transactions. learn more Short-Term Rental Facilitators All AIDA properties are pre-approved for Airbnb and UnderTheDoormat. We connect you with trusted short-term rental agencies to handle the rest. learn more AIDA Credit Card Apply for an exclusive AIDA-branded credit card offering lifestyle rewards, discounts within AIDA, and benefits for property-related expenses. learn more Insignia Program DarGlobal covers the card’s annual fee, unlocking 24/7 personal-concierge and shopping services, bespoke travel planning, and invitations to exclusive events and partner privileges worldwide. learn more Owner Perks Gain access to exclusive discounts, partner offers, and premium services across AIDA and selected DarGlobal properties. learn more Remote Handover & Key Release Can’t be in Oman for handover? No problem. DarGlobal offers secure remote handover services and digital documentation to ensure a smooth key collection process, wherever you are. learn more Free Assignment Service Benefit from a complimentary assignment service for ownership transfer prior to handover, subject to terms and conditions. learn more Owner-Association Representation Stay informed and involved through DarGlobal’s support in establishing and participating in the AIDA Owners’ Association, ensuring your voice is heard. learn more Mortgage Program for Foreign Owners Exclusive mortgage program in Oman for resident and non-resident buyers, designed to enhance real estate returns. learn more We value our privacy We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, serve personalized content, and analyze our traffic. title: DarGlobal Blog | Insights on Luxury Real Estate, Investments

DarGlobal Blog | Insights on Luxury Real Estate, Investments
Register Interest
+966 8001188081
English
العربية
Blogs
Nov 13, 2026
Top Features High-Net-Worth Buyers Look For
The definition of prestige in real estate has undergone a fundamental transformation. While opulent finishes and prime addresses remain prerequisites, today's HNWI (High-Net-Worth Individual) buyer views a residence as an extension of their personal values, wellness philosophy, and security requirements.
Nov 06, 2026
Future of Branded Residences
The global real estate landscape is undergoing a monumental shift, with the market for high-end branded developments expanding at unprecedented speeds. Crossing beyond traditional hotel-operated apartments, the next generation of property projects blends hospitality, architectural prestige, and lifestyle curation to redefine the concept of luxury living.
Oct 30, 2026
How to Evaluate a Luxury Property Before You Invest
Investing in high-end real estate offers substantial wealth preservation, capital appreciation, and strong market status. However, the luxury market operates under very different rules than traditional residential housing. Standard valuation formulas often fall short because premium properties trade on emotional value, architectural distinction, and geographic exclusivity rather than strictly square footage.
Oct 16, 2026
Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate
When building a high-value real estate portfolio, evaluating the trade-offs between capital growth and rental yield stands as one of the most critical steps in strategy development. Both metrics serve distinct roles in wealth generation, but in the luxury segment, they behave differently than in mass-market residential property.
Oct 09, 2026
Luxury Waterfront Properties: What Makes Them So Valuable?
Few asset classes hold the prestige, financial resilience, and emotional appeal of a waterfront luxury property. Whether situated along iconic coastlines, serene lakeshores, or private island enclaves, prime waterfront real estate consistently commands the highest valuations in global real estate.
Oct 05, 2026
The Complete Guide to Investing in Dubai Off-Plan Properties
Investing in real estate has consistently proven to be a cornerstone of global wealth creation, and few markets capture the imagination of international investors quite like Dubai.
Sep 25, 2026
What Makes a Luxury Real Estate Developer Worth Investing With?
Investing in prime property requires evaluating the entity building the asset just as rigorously as the geographic location itself. In the upper echelons of residential real estate, a developer’s execution capability, strategic vision, and brand equity directly influence total returns.
Sep 18, 2026
How Luxury Real Estate Supports Global Mobility and Residency
For high-net-worth individuals, physical property is no longer merely a domestic store of wealth or a passive asset class. In an increasingly interconnected economic landscape, prime residential real estate serves as an anchor for international freedom, sovereign risk management, and borderless lifestyle planning.
Sep 11, 2026
Why Luxury Real Estate Should Be Part of Every Investment Portfolio
High-net-worth investors and family offices constantly refine their capital allocation strategies to protect wealth while driving sustainable growth. While equities, fixed income, and venture capital remain traditional staples, adding physical prime property introduces unique structural stability.
Sep 04, 2026
How Luxury Real Estate Creates Long-Term Wealth
High-net-worth individuals consistently turn to prime property as a cornerstone for portfolio expansion and legacy preservation. Unlike standard housing, prime residential real estate operates under distinct financial mechanics. Examining the foundational drivers of luxury property ROI demonstrates how strategic acquisitions secure lasting wealth across market cycles.
Aug 31, 2026
Luxury Real Estate Trends That Will Shape 2026
The high-end residential housing market is entering an era defined by intentionality, technological discretion, and health-focused architecture. Modern high-net-worth buyers are re-evaluating what true luxury means, shifting away from ostentatious displays of size toward functional elegance, sustainability, and personal well-being. Understanding the dominant luxury real estate trends is essential for investors, developers, and homeowners looking to build long-term value in a dynamic market.
Aug 21, 2026
Is Buying a Second Home Still a Smart Investment?
The real estate landscape has evolved rapidly over the past few years. Driven by shifting workplace norms, evolving interest rate environments, and changing lifestyle priorities, buyers are looking at real estate with a fresh perspective. One central question consistently emerges for high-net-worth individuals and capital allocators: Is buying a second home still a smart investment?
Aug 14, 2026
Best Countries for Luxury Real Estate Investment in 2026
The global prime property market is undergoing a structural transformation. Driven by evolving financial policies, strategic wealth preservation initiatives, and dynamic economic shifts, high-net-worth individuals are continually evaluating where to allocate long-term capital. Identifying the best countries to invest in real estate requires a balanced framework that goes far beyond aesthetic appeal. Smart cross-border investors prioritize high capital appreciation potential, robust rental yields, direct tax optimization, structural liquidity, and long-term residency advantages.
Aug 10, 2026
How International Investors Buy Luxury Property with Confidence
The global distribution of private capital has changed the way premium real estate is acquired. Today, high-net-worth individuals do not limit their portfolios to their home countries. Instead, they actively seek institutional stability, lifestyle flexibility, and high capital growth across multiple borders.
Jul 17, 2026
Why Dubai Remains the World's Leading Luxury Property Market
The global ultra-luxury property sector is experiencing a period of significant recalibration. While traditional wealth capitals navigate regulatory changes, tax adjustments, and slowing growth, one market consistently defies global trends. Dubai has firmly established itself not merely as a regional safe haven, but as the absolute capital of the global elite.
Jul 13, 2026
Why Branded Residences Continue to Outperform Traditional Luxury Homes
The global ultra-luxury housing market is undergoing a structural evolution. For decades, the pinnacle of real estate investment was defined purely by raw metrics: prime square footage, coveted zip codes, and custom architectural finishes. Today, affluent global citizens demand something far more comprehensive.
Jul 09, 2026
Luxury Real Estate Investment: Where Should You Invest in 2026?
The global landscape of wealth distribution and lifestyle mobility is shifting rapidly. For high-net-worth individuals, securing a resilient asset class is more than a financial objective. It is a lifestyle imperative. As traditional markets stabilize, savvy capital is rotating into premier, high-growth corridors.
Jan 21, 2026
The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap
In the late 1960s, Dubai Airport used to operate from 07:00 to 13:00, handling just a few hundred passengers a day. After 13:00, the airport manager (more like a caretaker) would lock the doors at 13:15 and take the keys with him. Today, Dubai moves more than 90M passengers a year, Abu Dhabi around 30M, and Doha over 50M - and extraordinary leap in one generation. But as transformative as aviation has been for opening the Gulf to the world, the region is now entering a new era of mobility, driven by land connections within the GCC.
Nov 09, 2025
Global Vision. Local Results.
Discover how Plano Group became a top-selling international agency for AIDA, Oman with DarGlobal — proving that performance transcends geography.

How to Buy a Villa in Dubai: Costs, Process & Best Areas

Can Foreigners Buy Property in Saudi Arabia: Eligibility & Legal Process

How to Invest in UK Property: Legal Requirements, Costs & ROI Insights

Waterfront Property: Definition, Value & Investment Potential
Learn what is waterfront property, its definition, value, and investment potential. Explore why owning waterfront real estate is a smart and lucrative choice.

How to Invest in Dubai Real Estate: Complete Guide, Risks & Returns
Learn how to invest in Dubai real estate with this complete guide. Explore top strategies, risks, and returns for smart property investment.

At the core of DarGlobal is a disciplined development model focused on delivering architecturally distinctive residential and mixed-use assets in high-growth global locations. From landmark towers featuring premium luxury apartments in Dubai and Qatar to bespoke, ultra-luxury villas in Spain and the GCC, every project is meticulously designed to balance elite desirability, structural efficiency, and long-term capital appreciation.

Building Luxury Communities
We create fully integrated communities designed for long-term living, investment stability, and enduring value.
From masterplanned environments in key regions to ultra-exclusive residential enclaves across UAE real estate and European markets, each community is built around connectivity, luxury lifestyle, and scarcity, ensuring sustained demand and generational relevance.

HOSPITALITY & LEISURE
We develop and operate hospitality-led assets in partnership with world-class global brands.
Our approach combines location, brand power, and operational excellence to create destinations that generate recurring income while enhancing the value of surrounding real estate.

Private membership
Dar Global is building a new generation of private membership clubs across its global destinations.
From an exclusive private members club in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to curated experiences and upcoming hospitality destinations for luxury properties in Dubai, these spaces are designed for residents, investors, and select members of our global community.

GOLF
Golf is a cornerstone of our community strategy, anchoring premium developments with globally recognized courses and club experiences.
These elite assets elevate positioning, attract high-net-worth buyers looking to buy luxury villas in Spain and the Middle East, and contribute to both lifestyle appeal and long-term asset performance.

Commercial
We develop high-quality commercial assets designed to generate stable, recurring income.
Strategically located and carefully curated, our commercial developments complement our residential portfolios across Qatar real estate and international markets while creating long-term value for investors.

asseT MANAGEMENT
REGULATED CAPITAL | GLOBAL REACH
| PARTNERSHIP FIRST
Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP) is the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary of DarGlobal, headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). DGCP deploys capital across global real estate markets, structuring premium opportunities in equity, debt, and hybrid instruments across the GCC, European, and US gateway markets. Built on the Group's premier development platform and powered by institutional discipline and analytical rigor, DGCP creates access to high-conviction strategies and proprietary deal flow for qualified investors and strategic partners.

Digital Assets | Liquidity | Democratized Access
We are pioneering new ways to access premium real estate investments through tokenization and digital ownership structures.
By leveraging advanced property technology, we aim to enhance liquidity, broaden investor access, and create more efficient pathways into high-quality luxury real estate assets globally.

About DarGlobal
Discover DarGlobal: Your Gateway to Luxury Real Estate Investment
DarGlobal is a premier international luxury real estate investment and development platform specialising in architecturally distinctive, design-led residences in the world's most sought-after destinations. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, we connect global capital with curated luxury living and property investment opportunities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and beyond.
Our elite portfolio spans masterplanned communities, branded luxury apartments, and hospitality-led destinations developed in partnership with iconic names from automotive, fashion, and hospitality. Whether investors seek recurring rental income, long-term capital appreciation, or geographic diversification, DarGlobal structures high-value real estate assets to align perfectly with institutional risk and return objectives.
With a seasoned leadership team, robust corporate governance, and a differentiated lifestyle brand, DarGlobal offers unparalleled access to exclusive projects that blend world-class architecture, resilient market fundamentals, and enduring desirability for global property buyers.

Frequently Asked Questions
DarGlobal creates luxury properties and branded residences that blend lifestyle, design, and long-term value. Through global partnerships and meticulous craftsmanship, we deliver premium homes and communities built with integrity and purpose — offering investors a sense of belonging, measurable value, and a legacy that lasts.
Why invest with DarGlobal?
DarGlobal is built for a new kind of global investor - one who values not just ROI, but ROE and ROL.
Who is DarGlobal?
DarGlobal develops real estate that speaks for itself, where lifestyle and value come together. We work with trusted global partners to create homes, communities, and destinations that grow in meaning and worth over time. Our approach is simple: deliver with integrity, design with care, and build with purpose. For those who see the world as their home, DarGlobal offers not just investment, but belonging — value you can measure, and pride you can feel, and a legacy you can pass forward.
What's ROI, ROE and ROL?
ROI (Return on Investment)
: measurable financial growth and lasting capital appreciation.
ROE (Return on Ego)
: the pride, identity, and social value of owning something that reflects who you are and what you stand for.
ROL (Return on Legacy)
: the confidence that what you build today will stand for something tomorrow.
We see the world as one connected home — where value is something you live, not just measure.
Our community of investors, partners, and visionaries builds with purpose and pride.
With DarGlobal, every investment becomes a lasting mark of trust, identity, and inheritance for the future.
What makes DarGlobal different?
We work with clarity, purpose, and collaboration — turning global partnerships into lasting opportunity. Guided by over three decades of experience, every development reflects trusted execution and measurable value.
Where does DarGlobal operate?
Across 14 cities in 9 countries, including Spain, London, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, the UK, and the Maldives.
What types of properties do you offer?
We develop residences, cities, and hospitality projects in the world’s most dynamic destinations. Each one is designed as both a home to live in and an investment to grow.
Why partner with global brands?
They deliver something rare — ROE (Return on Ego): the pride of owning what few can, and the distinction of belonging to a world defined by rarity, scarcity, and status.
Each collaboration is designed to create an asset of identity and desire.
Can international buyers invest?
Yes. DarGlobal is built for the global citizen — our destinations welcome international investors with full ownership rights, residency privileges, and secure, transparent investment frameworks.
How does the buying process work?
Select your property, consult our advisors, reserve securely, and complete your purchase digitally or through our global offices.
Investing with DarGlobal
Experience smart global investing with DarGlobal — from Dubai to London, discover curated opportunities in world-class developments.
How can I invest in DarGlobal properties?
Investing with DarGlobal is designed to be seamless and global. Choose a project, speak with our advisors, and secure your unit digitally or through any of our international offices. Whether you live in Dubai, Riyadh, Jeddah, Muscat, Doha, London, Marbella, or New York — your investment journey begins wherever you are.
What are the benefits of investing in off-plan luxury properties?
Off-plan at DarGlobal means entering early into high-growth destinations, benefiting from attractive prices, flexible payment plans, and the appreciation that comes with world-class design and brand collaborations. It’s not just smart investing — it’s securing future value today.
Are DarGlobal projects suitable for international investors?
Absolutely. DarGlobal is built for global citizens. Our destinations offer secure frameworks, full ownership rights, residency benefits, and a transparent buying process — making international investment simple, strategic, and protected.
What kind of returns can I expect?
Each development is strategically positioned for capital appreciation and strong rental yields. From premium Dubai residences to branded Marbella villas and waterfront Muscat properties, returns grow as the cities grow — delivering ROI, ROE, and ROL.
Is my investment with DarGlobal secure and transparent?
Yes. With over three decades of delivery, DarGlobal is anchored in trust, clarity, and transparent processes. Every investor is protected by local regulations, escrow systems, and our global partnerships — ensuring peace of mind at every step.
Our Luxury Properties & Projects
Discover what makes our luxury properties and iconic collaborations truly exceptional worldwide.
What types of properties does DarGlobal offer?
From branded villas and penthouses to resort-style residences and city apartments — every DarGlobal property is crafted for lifestyle, investment, and legacy. These are homes designed to live beautifully and invest confidently.
Where are DarGlobal properties located?
Across the world’s most desirable destinations:
Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Muscat, Doha, Riyadh, Jeddah, Costa del Sol (Spain), the Maldives, London,
and more — each chosen for growth, desirability, and global appeal.
What are co-branded residences?
These are homes crafted in collaboration with the world’s most iconic luxury brands — from fashion to hospitality to design — offering elevated architecture, exclusive services, and long-term value driven by global brand equity.
Which upcoming projects are open for investment?
Multiple developments across the UAE, Oman, KSA, Spain, London, and the Maldives are currently open, including high-demand branded districts and resort-led communities. Your advisor can guide you to the opportunities best aligned with your investment goals.
Do DarGlobal properties come fully furnished or customizable?
Many of our branded residences are offered fully furnished with world-class interior design. Select projects also offer customization options, allowing buyers to tailor their home to their lifestyle and aesthetic.
Collaborations & Brand Partnerships
Where luxury craftsmanship meets global identity.
Which global brands has DarGlobal collaborated with?
DarGlobal partners with iconic names across fashion, hospitality, and design — delivering residences that carry global distinction and rarity.
What makes co-branded residences unique?
They offer something few can own:
ROE — Return on Ego.
Craftsmanship, scarcity, elevated lifestyle, and brand legacy come together to create homes that are not just lived in — they are admired.
How do partnerships enhance property value?
Brand equity drives desirability, rental performance, resale value, and long-term appreciation. A branded residence is not just a property — it’s a global asset backed by decades of reputation.
Which upcoming collaborations or branded projects are launching soon?
DarGlobal continues to expand through new partnerships across the GCC, Europe, and Asia. Speak with our advisors to register for upcoming launches and exclusive early access.
How can I invest in a co-branded DarGlobal residence?
Choose your preferred development and reserve your unit through our global sales team. International and remote investors can complete the entire process digitally with full transparency.
Buying Process & Ownership
Discover a seamless buying experience tailored for HNWI and global investors.
What is the process to buy a DarGlobal property?
1. Choose your property
2. Review the investment plan with our advisors
3. Reserve your unit securely
4. Sign digitally or through our offices worldwide
5. Complete payment and registration with full support from our team
Can international buyers purchase DarGlobal properties?
Yes — our global structure is designed for international ownership, offering straightforward procedures and access to attractive residency pathways where applicable.
What payment plans are available?
Each development offers flexible installment plans, making global investing accessible while maximizing capital efficiency.
How does property registration work?
Registration is completed with the respective land department or governing authority in each country. DarGlobal provides full guidance to ensure a smooth and compliant process.
What documents or approvals are required to complete a property purchase?
Typically:
1. Passport copy
2. Contact information
3. Reservation form
4. Payment details
Certain markets may require additional documentation, and our advisors guide you step-by-step.

title: THE INTERNSHIP
text:
THE INTERNSHIP PROGRAM The DarGlobal Internship Program is designed to provide students and recent graduates with a unique, hands-on opportunity to gain invaluable experience in the dynamic world of real estate development. Interns will work alongside industry professionals, contribute to exciting live projects, and acquire practical skills that will set them up for long-term career success. This program offers not just exposure to day-to-day operations but deep insight into the strategic aspects of real estate development. What We Look For Strong problem-solving abilities Effective communication skills A collaborative mindset Enthusiasm for learning Explore open internship roles Marketing Intern dubai, united arab emirates Marketing We’re looking for a creative and driven Marketing Intern to support our marketing team in executing campaigns, managing content, and analyzing performance. This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in brand development, digital marketing, and communications across various platforms. text:
Investor | Luxury Second Homes by DarGlobal Register Interest +966 8001188081 English العربية Investor Relations ABOUT INVESTORS CORPORATE GOVERNANCE DarGlobal Today DarGlobal PLC is an international real estate developer specializing in exclusive luxury developments across the world’s most coveted cosmopolitan cities. Catering to global citizens seeking prime investments, second homes, and luxury living, DarGlobal transforms real estate into economic catalysts, unlocking opportunities for both investors and the countries it enters. DarGlobal has partnered with over 11 world-renowned luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. These collaborations offer unique investment opportunities in global cities, providing both wealth growth and protection. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, DarGlobal goes beyond property development; it drives economic transformation by attracting international clients and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI). With a presence in 13 international cities across 8 countries, DarGlobal’s portfolio spans the United Kingdom, Spain, Greece, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, the United States, and Qatar. The company is also expanding into world-class hospitality, developing luxury hotels in Dubai, Muscat, Riyadh and Jeddah. To support its international clientele, DarGlobal has sales and customer service offices in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha. FACTSHEET LEADERS IN REAL ESTATE Listed on the London Stock Exchange since 2023, we’re building on three decades of development know-how. Every opportunity is strategically curated and backed by market insight. Our partners represent forward-thinking luxury brands who share our passion for design: Aston Martin, W Hotels, Missoni, Automobili Lamborghini, to name a few. A GLOBAL PRESENCE From London to Dubai, our portfolio spans 14 cities and 9 countries, offering prime access to the world’s most dynamic markets. We serve our international clientele from hubs in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha. leadership As DarGlobal’s CEO, Ziad El Chaar leads the company’s strategic expansion and partnerships. Under his stewardship, DarGlobal was listed on the London Stock Exchange in 2023 and has forged exclusive collaborations with likeminded luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. El Chaar has pioneered DarGlobal’s diversification into the hospitality sector, while also overseeing innovative development projects across key markets in the UAE, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain and UK. title: The power of living; subTitle: Trump Golf Villas; description: The Trump Golf Villas are directly situated at the frontlines of the Trump International Golf Club Oman in Aida, Muscat. title: Once in a lifetime; subTitle: Trump Cliff Villas; description: Introducing The Trump Cliff Villas, an exclusive collection of 3-bedroom residences perched on the cliffside, offering unparalleled sea views next to the Trump Hotel.

title: Azure Oceanfront Villas Interiors by Fendi Casa; subTitle: Azure Oceanfront Villas; description: Azure Oceanfront Villas is a limited collection of five-bedroom residences, suspended 130 meters above the sea, inside AIDA, Oman’s most prestigious gated coastal community.
Interiors by FENDI Casa.
Nothing in front of you. Nothing above you.
Only the horizon.

Global Real Estate Developments & Luxury Properties
At the core of DarGlobal is a disciplined development model focused on delivering architecturally distinctive residential and mixed-use assets in high-growth global locations. From landmark towers featuring premium luxury apartments in Dubai and Qatar to bespoke, ultra-luxury villas in Spain and the GCC, every project is meticulously designed to balance elite desirability, structural efficiency, and long-term capital appreciation.

Building Luxury Communities
We create fully integrated communities designed for long-term living, investment stability, and enduring value.
From masterplanned environments in key regions to ultra-exclusive residential enclaves across UAE real estate and European markets, each community is built around connectivity, luxury lifestyle, and scarcity, ensuring sustained demand and generational relevance.

HOSPITALITY & LEISURE
We develop and operate hospitality-led assets in partnership with world-class global brands.
Our approach combines location, brand power, and operational excellence to create destinations that generate recurring income while enhancing the value of surrounding real estate.

Private membership
Dar Global is building a new generation of private membership clubs across its global destinations.
From an exclusive private members club in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to curated experiences and upcoming hospitality destinations for luxury properties in Dubai, these spaces are designed for residents, investors, and select members of our global community.

GOLF
Golf is a cornerstone of our community strategy, anchoring premium developments with globally recognized courses and club experiences.
These elite assets elevate positioning, attract high-net-worth buyers looking to buy luxury villas in Spain and the Middle East, and contribute to both lifestyle appeal and long-term asset performance.

Commercial
We develop high-quality commercial assets designed to generate stable, recurring income.
Strategically located and carefully curated, our commercial developments complement our residential portfolios across Qatar real estate and international markets while creating long-term value for investors.

REGULATED CAPITAL | GLOBAL REACH
| PARTNERSHIP FIRST
Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP) is the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary of DarGlobal, headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). DGCP deploys capital across global real estate markets, structuring premium opportunities in equity, debt, and hybrid instruments across the GCC, European, and US gateway markets. Built on the Group's premier development platform and powered by institutional discipline and analytical rigor, DGCP creates access to high-conviction strategies and proprietary deal flow for qualified investors and strategic partners.

We are pioneering new ways to access premium real estate investments through tokenization and digital ownership structures.
By leveraging advanced property technology, we aim to enhance liquidity, broaden investor access, and create more efficient pathways into high-quality luxury real estate assets globally.

About DarGlobal
Discover DarGlobal: Your Gateway to Luxury Real Estate Investment
DarGlobal is a premier international luxury real estate investment and development platform specialising in architecturally distinctive, design-led residences in the world's most sought-after destinations. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, we connect global capital with curated luxury living and property investment opportunities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and beyond.
Our elite portfolio spans masterplanned communities, branded luxury apartments, and hospitality-led destinations developed in partnership with iconic names from automotive, fashion, and hospitality. Whether investors seek recurring rental income, long-term capital appreciation, or geographic diversification, DarGlobal structures high-value real estate assets to align perfectly with institutional risk and return objectives.
With a seasoned leadership team, robust corporate governance, and a differentiated lifestyle brand, DarGlobal offers unparalleled access to exclusive projects that blend world-class architecture, resilient market fundamentals, and enduring desirability for global property buyers.

Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP) is the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary of DarGlobal, headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). DGCP deploys capital across global real estate markets, structuring premium opportunities in equity, debt, and hybrid instruments across the GCC, European, and US gateway markets. Built on the Group's premier development platform and powered by institutional discipline and analytical rigor, DGCP creates access to high-conviction strategies and proprietary deal flow for qualified investors and strategic partners.

About DarGlobal
Discover DarGlobal: Your Gateway to Luxury Real Estate Investment
DarGlobal is a premier international luxury real estate investment and development platform specialising in architecturally distinctive, design-led residences in the world's most sought-after destinations. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, we connect global capital with curated luxury living and property investment opportunities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and beyond.
Our elite portfolio spans masterplanned communities, branded luxury apartments, and hospitality-led destinations developed in partnership with iconic names from automotive, fashion, and hospitality. Whether investors seek recurring rental income, long-term capital appreciation, or geographic diversification, DarGlobal structures high-value real estate assets to align perfectly with institutional risk and return objectives.
With a seasoned leadership team, robust corporate governance, and a differentiated lifestyle brand, DarGlobal offers unparalleled access to exclusive projects that blend world-class architecture, resilient market fundamentals, and enduring desirability for global property buyers.

title: DarGlobal Appoints Ene Construccion Amaz SL as Main Contractor for Tierra Viva – A Luxury Villa Development with Design Inspired by Automobili Lamborghini
text:
DarGlobal Appoints Ene Construccion Amaz SL as Main Contractor for Tierra Viva – A Luxury Villa Development with Design Inspired by Automobili Lamborghini
Register Interest
+966 8001188081
English
العربية
Articles And News
Select Press
Nov 19, 2026
Dar Global and The Trump Organization Mark Successful Launch of $700M Qatar Destination to International Investors
Dar Global, the London-listed international luxury real estate developer, and The Trump Organization marked the official launch of Trump International Simaisma, Qatar, at an exclusive event held in Palm Beach, Florida.
Nov 16, 2026
Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion
Dar Global, the London-listed international luxury real estate developer, today announced plans for a new mixed-use development in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with an estimated gross development value (GDV) of approximately SAR 1 billion (USD 267 million).
Oct 26, 2026
Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate
Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the alternative asset management arm of London-listed luxury international developer Dar Global, today announced its strategic focus on deploying capital across international real estate markets through a dedicated cross-border mandate spanning the GCC, Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States, alongside high-conviction investments in Dubai.
Oct 07, 2026
Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest
Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, has officially opened sales for its Trump Villas within Trump International Golf Club Simaisma, Qatar, witnessing unprecedented demand and strong investor interest since sales launched on 1 October.
Sep 30, 2026
Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (HY 2025: US$155.4 million).
Aug 06, 2026
Dar Global appoints Gulf Asia Contracting for Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai
Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded the construction contract to Gulf Asia Contracting for the podium of Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai. Following the successful completion of all enabling works, due in September 2026, this appointment marks the project's transition into the next stage of construction and another significant milestone in the delivery of one of Dubai's most anticipated luxury developments.
Jun 29, 2026
Dar Global and Fendi Casa announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman
Dar Global and FENDI Casa announce the launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas, a collection of ultra-luxury mansions with interiors by FENDI Casa, set within the prestigious AIDA clifftop community in Muscat, Oman. Conceived by Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate company, AIDA is one of the most expansive and exclusive mixed-use real estate developments globally.
Jun 18, 2026
DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Master Community Infrastructure Contract To Compass And Bin Omairah In Wadi Safar, Diriyah, Riyadh
DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded a SAR 338 million infrastructure contract for its ultra-exclusive Rayana community in Wadi Safar, Riyadh, to Compass and Bin Omairah Company for Contracting LLC
Jun 16, 2026
DarGlobal marks five years of global expansion with $23bln development portfolio and a bold vision for the future
London-listed luxury real estate developer DarGlobal celebrates its fifth anniversary, reaching a $23 billion development portfolio across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Spain, Greece and the UK, serving investors from over 125 nationalities.
Apr 16, 2026
Emirates NBD successfully executes USD 250 Million Syndicated Term Loan facility for Darglobal, Accelerating Global Growth and Expansion
Emirates NBD, a leading banking group in the Middle East, North Africa and Türkiye (MENAT) region, has announced the successful execution of a USD 250 million syndicated term loan facility (“Project Radium II”) for Darglobal plc, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer. Darglobal plc secured this USD 250 million financing as part of its continued growth and expansion across key global markets.
Dec 07, 2025
DarGlobal and Art District Real Estate Development Announce MAD, Muscat’s Marine, Art & Digital District
DarGlobal (LSE: DAR), the London-listed luxury real estate developer, in partnership with Art District Real Estate Development, today announced the start of the collaboration to launch and develop MAD, Muscat Marine, Art & Digital District, a transformative new coastal destination that integrates oceanfront living, luxury hospitality, culture-led enterprise, and future-focused finance and digital industries.
Apr 23, 2026
DarGlobal appoints Al Dahlawi Company for Contracting, LLC, to deliver main works at Amaya, Jeddah’s “Beverly Hills” in the making, home to Trump Plaza Jeddah.
DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has appointed Al Dahlawi Company for Contracting as the contractor to deliver works at Amaya, its flagship masterplan development in Jeddah. This appointment marks a key milestone in advancing the integrated urban district, which spans approximately one million square meters in one of the city’s most strategically connected locations.
Mar 31, 2026
Darglobal delivers industry-leading 17.3% ROE in 2025, Strengthened position for evolving market conditions
Further to the Full Year Results for 2025 issued on 11 March 2026, Darglobal, the luxury international real estate developer, reports a Return on Equity ('ROE') of 17.3% for the financial year ended 31 December 2025 ('FY25'). This performance places the Group among the highest-returning listed developers in the UK and Europe.
Feb 18, 2026
World Liberty Financial to Tokenize Trump International Hotel & Resort, Maldives, in Partnership with DarGlobal and Securitize
World Liberty Financial (“WLFI”) has today announced plans to tokenize Trump International Hotel & Resort, Maldives, in partnership with Securitize, Inc. a leading platform for tokenizing real-world assets, and DarGlobal PLC (LSE: DAR), an international luxury real estate developer. This initial offering reflects WLFI's broader strategy to design, structure, and distribute WLFI-branded tokenized real-world asset offerings.
Feb 12, 2026
DarGlobal Strengthens China Partnerships as Saudi Real Estate Market Opens to Global Investors
The delegation held senior-level meetings across Beijing, Shenzhen, and Shanghai with leading real estate developers, engineering groups, and contracting partners, focused on advancing collaboration aligned with the Kingdom's ongoing economic transformation. As Saudi Arabia's largest trading partner, China represents a natural strategic counterpart as international capital gains greater access to the Saudi property market.

We’re turning physical assets into digital tokens - fractional shares of our premium properties that investors can buy, sell, or hold. This opens the door to new opportunities: Simplified Access Invest in DarGlobal’s most exclusive projects from anywhere in the world. Liquidity with Confidence Trade your tokens through regulated platforms while knowing you’re backed by real-world assets. Security & Transparency Every transaction is recorded on a secure blockchain, ensuring full visibility and trust. Fractional Ownership Own a share of luxury residences without the complexity of traditional real estate deals. Why Tokenization with DarGlobal? We deliver real investments with real returns. Tokenization is a new key unlocking smarter, more agile ownership models: It’s not about trends, it’s about expanding your portfolio. It’s not about crypto hype, it’s about enhancing liquidity. It’s not about making noise, it’s about giving global citizens more control. With tokenization, DarGlobal is future-proofing real estate investment for discerning investors. Discover the freedom to live anywhere. Tax benefits. Long-term stability. Strategic investment opens doors to new possibilities. Read More Saudi Arabia: Residency Through Investment Invest 4M SAR (Approx 1.07M USD) to secure Saudi residency and its exclusive benefits. Enjoy a 30-year corporate tax exemption, ensuring long-term financial advantages. The Saudi Riyal (SAR) is pegged to USD, offering currency stability for investors. Investors can now open a bank account in Saudi Arabia while on a visit visa. Oman: Lifetime Residency for Investors Invest in real estate and obtain lifetime residency. Hassle-free bank account setup for investors. 0% Personal income tax ensures greater financial gains. 0% Import or export duties, making business operations seamless. Qatar: A Gateway to Prosperity Tax Benefits No personal income tax and no property tax, maximizing returns. Competitive corporate tax rates make Qatar an attractive business hub. Permanent Residency Obtain permanent residency by investing 3,650,000 QAR (1 million USD), providing long-term residency and access to Qatar’s benefits. Investor Visa Program Offers residency to investors who purchase real estate in Qatar with a minimum investment of 728,000 QAR (200,000 USD). Upon confirmation of payment, the Ministry of Justice issues a Sanad Mabdayi, a temporary title deed recognizing ownership. This enables investors to apply for residency even before project completion, under the new government-approved framework. United Arab Emirates (UAE): 10-Year Golden Visa Invest 2 million AED (Approx 545,000 USD) in real estate, now including off-plan properties, to obtain a 10-year Golden Visa. 0% Income Tax ensures maximum earnings. 0% Property Tax making real estate investment even more lucrative. Take the first step towards a secure and prosperous future. Join DarGlobal | Luxury Real Estate Register Interest +966 8001188081 English العربية YOUR CHANCE TO WIN A TRIP TO DUBAI DarGlobal invites you to enter our exclusive broker raffle for a chance to win a fully hosted luxury experience in Dubai where you’ll meet our team and discover unforgettable moments in the city. REGISTER TO ENTER THE RAFFLE Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai aida, muscat, oman MARRIOTT GOLF RESIDENCES, AIDA, OMAN top of the astera, al marjan island, rak SUBMIT terms & conditions JOIN THE RAFFLE - WIN A TRIP TO DUBAI By participating in this campaign, brokers agree to the following Terms & Conditions: 1. Eligibility Only registered brokers with DarGlobal are eligible to participate. All participants must hold a valid passport with at least 6 months’ validity from DDMMYYYY. Visa Application will be handled by the applicants themselves and DAR GLOBAL is not responsible nor can help for providing visa approvals to the UAE. In the incident that applicants are not able to have their visas approved, the prize will be forfeited without compensation or substitution. 2. How to Enter Eligible brokers will automatically be entered into the raffle upon completing the registration Each registered broker is entitled to single entry 3. Period This Raffle commences on the DD MM YYYY at (timing) and will end on DD MM YYYY at (timing) 4. Reward Winner will win a trip for two (2) to the Dubai for a total of X nights The trip will include First Class or Business Class flights (depending on availability), including hotel, full board and many surprises curated by DarGlobal. The reward is non-transferable, non-exchangeable, and has no cash value. 5. Announcement & Trip Details The winner will be selected randomly from all eligible brokers. Winner will be contacted directly by DDMMYYYY, with trip details shared thereafter. If the winner cannot be reached within X days, DarGlobal reserves the right to select another eligible broker. The trip is tentatively scheduled for Q3 or Q4 2025 (exact dates to be confirmed). 6. Disqualification DarGlobal reserves the right to disqualify any broker found to have provided false or misleading information or engaged in fraudulent activity. 7. General DarGlobal reserves the right to amend these Terms & Conditions or cancel the campaign at any time without prior notice. Participation constitutes acceptance of these Terms & Conditions. Invest in Aida
Muscat
Oman
Discover the epitome of luxury at Aida, Muscat, Oman, where sophisticated design meets breathtaking vistas 130m above the shoreline. Indulge in the exclusivity of our limited-edition 3-bedroom villas and 1 to 3-bedroom branded apartments, crafted in partnership with a renowned luxury hotel operator. Perched on the clifftops, each residence promises ultimate privacy, modern amenities, and direct access to lush landscapes and vibrant community hubs. Invest in Aida for a life of serenity and prestige on Oman’s pristine coast, with only a few units remaining.

Each residence has been meticulously designed to offer not just a home but a lifestyle that is both lavish and unique. Immerse yourself in the exclusivity and sophistication detailed below.

Oman is quickly becoming one of the most prominent commercial and cultural hubs in the region and is rapidly becoming a prime investment destination due to its attractive benefits. From its favorable tax environment and its strategic location as a gateway to the Middle East and Africa, Oman offers countless opportunities for businesses to grow and thrive.

La Collina
Jeddah
KSA
La Collina surpasses the typical mixed-use development, true to its name, it’s an elevated vision of urban living in Jeddah. Rising above the bustling cityscape of Jeddah, La Collina combines the beauty of elevated terrain with the innovation of modern urban planning.
Covering approximately 863,000 sqm, La Collina offers unparalleled investment opportunities through its residential, commercial and recreational spaces. Here, tradition and progress harmonize to shape a vibrant community on higher grounds.
About
Urban Community Living

A Rare Opportunity in Jeddah’s Growth Story
Secure your spot in La Collina, Jeddah’s rising landmark. A master-planned community blending urban living with heritage and future ambition. With high demand and turnkey investment options, it’s a prime opportunity for strong returns.
View all
Prime Location in Jeddah
Located 85 meters above sea level, La Collina’s elevated, flood-resistant terrain provides safety, cooler temperatures, and panoramic views. With uninterrupted access to the Red Sea coastline and seamless connectivity to Jeddah’s key landmarks, it combines strategic positioning with unparalleled comfort.

WHY INVEST
Saudi Arabia is undergoing a transformative economic revolution. Under the Vision 2030 initiative, the country is diversifying its economy, attracting investments, and fostering a business-friendly environment.
Elevated Living – 85m above sea level for safety, cooler temperatures, and panoramic views.
Red Sea Access – Direct route to the coastline for leisure and connectivity.
Prime Location – Minutes from Jeddah’s key landmarks for convenience.
Timeless Design – Modern Hijazi architecture with premium quality.
Thriving Community – Schools, parks, and retail hubs within walking distance.
A Unique Investment Opportunity
La Collina’s masterplan seamlessly blends modern living, world-class infrastructure, and vibrant community spaces. Offering residential elegance, commercial opportunities, and recreational areas, it fosters connection, convenience, and well-being—elevating urban life while honoring Jeddah’s heritage and future.

Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
Dubai

Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the Middle East's first and only Trump-branded address, developed by DarGlobal on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance to Downtown Dubai. The development combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in one building. Units span 109 to 722 sqm across one- to three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, with sea or Burj Khalifa views from every unit.
PROPERTY TYPE

UNIT TYPE

Under Development

FEATURING
The highest pool in the world
Challenge Everything. Stop At Nothing.
Step inside. Look around. This is what winning looks like. Residences & penthouses
with soaring ceilings and bespoke finishes. Every inch, a statement of dominance.
Overlook the shimmering skyline, the grandeur of Burj Khalifa or the limitless sea.
These are the headquarters for the ambitions of visionaries,
disruptors, and game-changers. And you’re next.
View All Images
KEY FEATURES
The Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai brings together three iconic worlds in one address: a five-star hotel, a members-only club, and private residences, each with its own state-of-the-art amenities.
Trump International Hotel & Tower
A five-star luxury hotel, joining the legacy of Trump organization most
iconic hotels.
Featuring fine dining, world-class entertainment, and true luxury at every
turn.
The Trump, Members-Only Club
The Trump Members-Only Club brings together wellness, business, and the
timeless atmosphere of a classic private club. Access is limited to members
only through an annual fee, with residents receiving priority access.
The Trump Residences
Featuring 1, 2, & 3-bedroom apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses, the residences dominate the skyline — with every unit offering a view.
Residents also enjoy exclusive access to the highest outdoor pool in the world.
AMENITIES OF THE TRUMP RESIDENCES
The following amenities are reserved exclusively for residents. Residents can also apply for membership to the Trump Members-Only Club to access its iconic spaces and experience the full lifestyle.
Rooftop infinity pool, the highest in the world
State of the art gym
Owners lounge
Kids play area
At the heart of it all
Located on Sheikh zayed road, right at the entrance of downtown, you are connected to it all without the congestion. Giving you direct access to Downtown, Dubai Mall, and the Dubai Fountains.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.
When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?
The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.
Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?
The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.
Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?
Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.
What is the Trump Members-Only Club?
The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.
What amenities are exclusive to residents of the Trump Residences?
Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building.
Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?
The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability.
How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai?
It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership.
How do I register interest or enquire about buying at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
Prospective buyers can register interest, download the project brochure, or book a private viewing through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

The Mulliner
149 Old Park Lane
London
Originally known as Gloucestor House, Nº149 Old Park Lane is a sophisticated landmark building with an important role in London’s architectural heritage.
Situated on the corner of Old Park Lane and Piccadilly, overlooking Green Park. Nº149 is one of the finest Grade II properties on Old Park Lane. It has been meticulously redeveloped and designed to the highest of standards throughout.
Property Type
5-Bedroom Apartment

Completed and sold out

A Momentous Welcome
Welcomed by a century of traditional architecture, The Mulliner salutes residents and guests with its traditionally refined entrance. It has retained many of the original classical and Art Nouveau features of the original design.

Fairway Villas
Aida
Oman
The Fairway Villas at AIDA Muscat sit directly on the frontline of Trump International Golf Club, Oman.
130 meters above the Muscat Riviera, overlooking the valley and the course.
This isn’t near the course.
It’s on it.
Property Type
Villa
Status
Under Development
Unit Type
4 & 5 Bedrooms
Area (SQM)
288 - 403
Photo Gallery
These are no ordinary interiors; they are a true testament to the Golfing lifestyle. Offering between 4 and 5 bedrooms, the Fairway Villas’ interiors are a masterful blend of modern luxury and timeless elegance. They are designed to provide inviting living spaces throughout the property to complement the breathtaking exteriors overlooking the championship golf course.
View All Images
Key Features
The Fairway villas are in close proximity to 5-star landmark destinations including, the Ritz Carlton, the Shangri-La resort, Nikki beach, and the Jumeirah hotel.

Oman is quickly becoming one of the most prominent commercial and cultural hubs in the region and is rapidly becoming a prime investment destination due to its attractive benefits. From its favorable tax environment and its strategic location as a gateway to the Middle East and Africa, Oman offers countless opportunities for businesses to grow and thrive.

real estate returns.

Located in Muscat and just 25 minutes from the international airport, AIDA rises 130 metres above sea level as a city within a city, combining nature, hospitality, and a championship golf destination.

AIDA

Situated in AIDA, a renowned golfing destination and exclusive gated community perched 130 meters above Muscat Bay, these villas embody idyllic coastal vibes. Just steps from the sea and mere moments from the golf course, each villa is thoughtfully designed for ultimate relaxation and epic play.
Own a villa among the most spectacular stretch of turf and sand – a holiday home to enjoy forever, or to offer as an exclusive vacation home rental.

Why INVEST
Oman is quickly becoming one of the most prominent commercial and cultural hubs in the region and is rapidly becoming a prime investment destination due to its attractive benefits. From its favorable tax environment and its strategic location as a gateway to the Middle East and Africa, Oman offers countless opportunities for businesses to grow and thrive.
Life-time Residency Visa for investors on projects in the ITC
Upcoming railway project connecting UAE to Muscat, Oman
100% Freehold Ownership for all nationalities*
0% Personal Income Tax Personal Income Tax
0% Capital Gains Tax
0% Inheritance tax Oman applies the inheritance laws of the investor’s country of origin, not local laws.
25 years exemption from corporate income taxes for special economic/free zone
Stable and Growing Economy Current inflation rate is one of the lowest globally.
One Of the Safest Countries in the world
Ideal Location easy access to the gulf, the Indian subcontinent and Africa
A Tourism Hub with Massive Potential of Growth aims to earn over us$ 22.5bn a year from tourism by 2040.
Cosmopolitan Home to a vibrant expat and foreign investor community with over 100 nationalities.
The Quality of Life Index by Numbeo ranked Oman 7th globally and 1st in both Asia and the Arab world in 2023.
Saudi-Oman Highway: Cuts travel by 16 hours, driving tourism and investment.
Exclusive mortgage program in Oman for resident
and non-resident buyers, designed to enhance
real estate returns.
Ideal Location
Located in Muscat and just 25 minutes from the international airport, AIDA rises 130 metres above sea level as a city within a city, combining nature, hospitality, and a championship golf destination.

Marriott Residences Aida, Oman
Aida
Oman
Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a branded residential complex at AIDA, Muscat, developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC using the Marriott name under license. The development offers fully furnished one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments from 60 to 194 sqm, with à la carte services including concierge, reception, doorman, lobby, and valet. Located 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera and 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand.
Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed, or sold by Marriott International or its affiliates.
What unit types and sizes are available?
The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.
What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences?
Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate.
What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?
The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.
When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed?
Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure.
Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers.
What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman?
Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.
Why invest in Muscat real estate now?
Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries worldwide. The country targets over $22.5 billion per year from tourism by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time by 16 hours between the two countries, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat will further strengthen regional connectivity and investment appeal.
How does Marriott Residences relate to the wider AIDA development?
Marriott Residences is one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal projects at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman, Trump Golf Villas, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a multi-branded, fully integrated resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera.

@type: Question; name: What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
@type: Answer; text: Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. Frequently Asked Questions
What is Trump Tower Jeddah?
Trump Tower Jeddah is a 47-floor Trump-branded seafront residential tower on the Jeddah Corniche, developed by DarGlobal. It offers one- to four-bedroom apartments and three- and four-bedroom penthouses with direct Red Sea views, alongside the Trump Private Club for residents and members.
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump Tower Jeddah?
The tower offers one-, two-, three-, and four-bedroom apartments as well as three- and four-bedroom penthouses, ranging from 70 to 365 sqm. All units are positioned on the Jeddah Corniche and face the Red Sea.
When will Trump Tower Jeddah be completed?
Completion is scheduled for December 2029. The project is under development by DarGlobal. Buyers can contact the sales team directly for current availability, payment plan structure, and brochure download.
Where exactly is Trump Tower Jeddah located?
The tower sits on the Jeddah Corniche along Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coastline. It offers easy access to the marina, the Formula 1 street circuit, and the King Fahd Fountain, placing residents at the intersection of coastal living and the city's key landmarks.
Is Trump Tower Jeddah developed by the Trump Organization?
No. Trump Tower Jeddah is owned and developed by DarGlobal Holdings Real Estate, which uses the Trump name and mark under a licensing agreement. The Trump Organization is not the owner, developer, or seller of the property.
What is the Trump Private Club at Trump Tower Jeddah?
The Trump Private Club is a resident-focused facility within the tower offering fine dining, a cigar lounge, meeting rooms, a gym, a yoga zone, swimming pool pool, kids pool, jacuzzi, and 24/7 concierge services.
What amenities does Trump Tower Jeddah offer?
Amenities include the Trump Private Club, 24/7 concierge, fine dining, and cigar lounge, meeting rooms, gym, yoga zone, pool, kids' pool, jacuzzi, and uninterrupted Red Sea views from one of the tallest towers in Jeddah Corniche.
Why invest in Jeddah real estate under Saudi Vision 2030?
Saudi Arabia offers 0% income tax and capital gains tax, a 30-year corporate tax exemption, and premium Saudi residency eligibility for investments of 4 million SAR or more. The SAR is pegged to the US dollar, and Saudi Arabia hosts Expo 2030 and the 2034 FIFA World Cup.
What makes Trump Tower Jeddah's location on the Corniche valuable?

AIDA
Muscat
Situated in AIDA, a renowned golfing destination and exclusive gated community perched 130 meters above Muscat Bay, these villas embody idyllic coastal vibes. Just steps from the sea and mere moments from the golf course, each villa is thoughtfully designed for ultimate relaxation and epic play.
Own a villa among the most spectacular stretch of turf and sand – a perfect home to enjoy forever, or to offer as an exclusive vacation home rental.

Why INVEST
Oman is quickly becoming one of the most prominent commercial and cultural hubs in the region and is rapidly becoming a prime investment destination due to its attractive benefits. From its favorable tax environment and its strategic location as a gateway to the Middle East and Africa, Oman offers countless opportunities for businesses to grow and thrive.
Life-time Residency Visa for investors on projects in the ITC
Upcoming railway project connecting UAE to Muscat, Oman
100% Freehold Ownership for all nationalities*
0% Personal Income Tax Personal Income Tax
0% Capital Gains Tax
0% Inheritance tax Oman applies the inheritance laws of the investor’s country of origin, not local laws.
25 years exemption from corporate income taxes for special economic/free zone
Stable and Growing Economy Current inflation rate is one of the lowest globally.
One Of the Safest Countries in the world
Ideal Location easy access to the gulf, the Indian subcontinent and Africa
A Tourism Hub with Massive Potential of Growth aims to earn over us$ 22.5bn a year from tourism by 2040.
Cosmopolitan Home to a vibrant expat and foreign investor community with over 100 nationalities.
The Quality of Life Index by Numbeo ranked Oman 7th globally and 1st in both Asia and the Arab world in 2023.
Saudi-Oman Highway: Cuts travel by 16 hours, driving tourism and investment.
Exclusive mortgage program in Oman for resident
and non-resident buyers, designed to enhance
real estate returns.
Ideal Location
Located in Muscat and just 25 minutes from the international airport, AIDA rises 130 metres above sea level as a city within a city, combining nature, hospitality, and a championship golf destination.
